help.title: How top-ups work
help.step1: The driver registers their Binance Pay ID in the app.
help.step2: They send USDT through Binance Pay to Pay ID {payId} ({name}). Minimum top-up: {min}.
help.step2Missing: They send USDT through Binance Pay to the Kuulis account. No Pay ID is configured yet: drivers cannot top up until you add it in
help.step3: In the app they notify the payment (with the order ID, if they have it); the notice shows up here as pending.
help.automatic: Automatic reconciliation is on: every minute the Binance Pay history is checked and each USDT payment whose payer matches a driver's Pay ID is credited. Payments that match nobody stay as "Unmatched" to be assigned by hand.
help.manual: Manual reconciliation: the server has no Binance credentials, so each pending notice is credited here after checking the payment in Binance.
help.unknownMode: If the server has Binance credentials, payments are credited automatically when the payer's Pay ID matches a driver's, and the rest stay "Unmatched". Without them, each pending notice is credited here by hand after checking it in Binance.
help.statuses: Crediting a top-up closes the driver's oldest pending notice and retries any pending fee.

transfers.help: Balance sent between drivers. Limit per driver: {limit} sent per month.

schedules.title: Tiers
schedules.how: The month's fee is the one of the highest tier the earnings exceed; a month without earnings costs 0. Each month uses the latest schedule in force, and a new schedule can only start next month or later, so a closed month never changes.
schedules.newHelp: Starts from the latest schedule. Each row is "earnings above" → fee. The first one starts at 0.
